column3: Implemented-note lifecycle rules: keep paths/symbols/defaults current in the same change, archive the complete triplet via dsh-archive-agent-notes, and never rewrite a decision without a new note plus cross-link.
9-byte pointer file whose entire content is the string "AGENTS.md" - an alias so Claude-style tools find the same agent instructions.
Hash sidecar recording EN/ZH hashes for six heading blocks (root, /problem, /decision, /alternatives-considered, /consequences, /verification) of the packed-install note.
Packed-install verifier passes --cache <consumerRoot>/.npm-cache to its own npm install so release rehearsals cannot grow the shared ambient npm cache; the finally removes cache+consumer.
Chinese twin; its 问题/决策 carry the --cache ownership argument and the three rejected alternatives (delete shared cache, change global TMPDIR, keep a persistent cache).
Hash sidecar for the browser-host-preferences note's six heading blocks (root anchor /agent-note-share-host-preferences-with-every-authenticated-browser).

Locality no longer selects a preference store: one Host settings.describe mirror plus ctx.configForms.get(entryId) serve every authenticated browser; only the "Open configuration file" button stays loopback-only.
Chinese twin; its 问题 states that the old locality gate made every Host-backed row inert on trusted remote and public deployments.
Hash sidecar for the blank-reconciliation note's six heading blocks.
Session Manager keeps accepted/running observations in a private per-Session-id set so a later session.list reporting blank:true cannot undo the Client's row conversion.
Chinese twin; its 问题 names the exact symptom (a session.list response undoing the conversion) and the reconnect trigger.
Hash sidecar for the session-open-read-coordination note's heading blocks.

Session cache identity is a per-service-instance Symbol('sessionPersistence') (Cordis returns different proxies), and auxiliary RPCs (skills/list, commands/list, goals/get, fileReferences/list) wait on sessions.using() before firing.
Chinese twin; its 问题 states the proxy-identity trap and the auxiliary-RPC race.
Hash sidecar for the prompt-tail-grace note's heading blocks.
Adds a validated promptTailGraceMs (default 0) to dsh-terminal-bash so a send that saw the OSC 133;D marker but not the printable "dsh> " tail waits idleSilenceMs+handoffGraceMs+promptTailGraceMs.
Chinese twin; its 问题 records the two-chunk Windows prompt render (marker, then "dsh> " 2-28 ms later) and the ~3 s per-send cost.
Hash sidecar for the bundled-console-host note's heading blocks.
Windows PTY allocation sets node-pty's useConptyDll:true so the bundled OpenConsole renders "dsh> " verbatim instead of the OS console host's malformed "\ndsh>\x1b[1C".
Chinese twin; its 问题 gives the pool-machine measurement (5 of 7 prompts malformed) that no tail bound could cover.
Hash sidecar for the reused-blank-preset note's heading blocks.

session.create with a named blank SessionId now runs the requested (or default) agentPreset instead of the preset recorded in the blank's log, fixing agent-preset/not-found for New Session and startup restoration.
Chinese twin; its 问题 names issue #2566 and the stale-blank-first ordering that poisoned every later New Session.
Hash sidecar for the job-lifecycle note's heading blocks.
Job registry appends job/registered and job/settled facts to the owning Session log with UUID-backed JobIds so SDK consumers can reconstruct a job's execution interval across registry restarts.
Chinese twin; its 问题 notes a background tool can return before the work finishes and that runtime-local ids repeat after a registry restart.
Hash sidecar for the session-list-fairness note's heading blocks.
ApiSessionList uses one monotonic listWorkSliceMs deadline (default 16 ms) and yields only when elapsed work exhausts it, instead of yielding per row; includes a full benchmark methodology.
Chinese twin; its 问题 notes that yielding per row adds thousands of event-loop round trips on cheap lists.
Hash sidecar for the background-shell-display note's heading blocks.

An explicit background bash/pwsh launch reuses the terminal command card but becomes a static command-only display after the launch acknowledgement - no run-state dot, exit code or empty-output placeholder.
Chinese twin; its 问题 explains why the launch acknowledgement cannot establish job completion.
Hash sidecar for the runtime-context-values note's heading blocks.

The checkout path and Web GUI URL move out of the system prompt into runtime context, because a changed prompt rewrites message 0 and breaks Claude's thinking-signature binding (400 Invalid signature ... bound to a different conversation).
Chinese twin; its 问题 table lists the operations (random --port, A/B checkouts, npm vs Desktop install) that changed the values invisibly.
Hash sidecar for the PTC note's heading blocks (root anchor /agent-note-ptc-mode-the-model-writes-typescript-against-the-tool-registry).
PTC mode: the model writes a TypeScript program against a generated SDK over the tool registry instead of emitting one tool call per step; ToolRuntime contributes only run_code plus the .d.ts.
Chinese twin; its 问题 cites Cloudflare's Code Mode and the token cost of re-entering every intermediate tool-result into context.
Hash sidecar for the approval-seam note's heading blocks.
One dsh-user-approval package owns the approval vocabulary and ctx.approval; answerers are approval/request waterfall listeners, and mounting no answerer is the fail-closed opt-out.
Chinese twin; its 问题 names the two callers (tools/pre-execute ask, sandbox post-denial escalation) and the ownership-routing problem.
Hash sidecar for the parallel-tool-call note's heading blocks.

Per-tool isConcurrencySafe(args) classifier is unary and fail-closed; consecutive parallel calls form a group, exclusive calls are barriers, results commit in model order under a rolling maxParallelToolCalls pool (default 10).
Chinese twin; its 决策 states that only an explicit true opts in and that concurrency is a host concern, not model-facing metadata.
Hash sidecar for the subagent-persona note's heading blocks.
Subagent persona is a child-scoped deployment:persona-prefix section, toolFilter is one live global registry rule (allow before deny, intersect), maxDepth is an absolute cap enforced at every start.
Chinese twin; its 决策 states plainly that the controls compose trusted same-process behavior but do not authorize it.
Hash sidecar for the persistent-PTY note's heading blocks.
Adds packages/terminal/ - agent-owned persistent line-oriented PTY sessions (ctx.terminals plus a bash backend) so shell-local cwd, env and interactive children survive across tool calls.
Chinese twin; its 问题 lists the gdb / REPL / ed workflows excluded by per-call shells.
Hash sidecar for the goal-tools note's heading blocks.

get_goal/create_goal/update_goal are exclusive-execution tools over ctx.goals; state changes need a live runtime-root agent plus a direct human message in the current turn, and durable compare-and-set id/revision.
Chinese twin; its 决策 rejects "rely on prompt instructions for authority" outright.
Hash sidecar for the typed-tool-returns note's heading blocks.

PTC bindings resolve to canonical JsonValue (not prose), the generated SDK declares ToolArgsMap/ToolOutputMap, failures reject with a real ToolCallError, and the outer payload ledger caps at maxOutputBytes = 64 MiB.
Chinese twin; its 决策 describes the flat pre-order token stream that removes structured-clone depth limits and the captured-intrinsic guard against model mutation.
Hash sidecar for the continuable-subagents note's heading blocks.
A continuable child has one durable Session and at most one live Activation; the Agent inbox is the only turn FIFO, sendMessage accepts only an exact live adjacent Agent, and teardown is child-first.
Chinese twin; its 决策 explains why a Task-backed manager creates two FIFOs with no single ordering authority.
Hash sidecar for the agent-teams note's heading blocks.

Every runtime root is the implicit Lead of a Team with a flat kebab-case roster, durable compare-and-set shared tasks with expectedRevision, and wait_agent blocking on a registered edge instead of model polling.
Chinese twin; its 决策 rejects treating task ownership or write scopes as locks ("false mutual exclusion is more dangerous than an explicit warning").
Hash sidecar for the context-form-vocabulary note's heading blocks.

MessageSource gains a producer-declared form (instructions/catalog/snapshot/notice/relay/recall) separate from kind, so a reader sees what was added instead of one wall of escaped JSON; opaque is the default.
Chinese twin; its 决策 explains why there is no presenter registry (the producing plugin owns the source and can record the facts directly).
Hash sidecar for the Windows-ACL-sandbox note's heading blocks.
Windows sandbox rung: CreateRestrictedToken WRITE_RESTRICTED plus Low integrity plus per-workspace/temp capability SIDs; the port of the windows-acl-restrict-poc fails closed on every API call.
Chinese twin; its 决策 explains why no new identity is needed (reads keep the caller's ambient access) and why mxc/AppContainer were rejected.
Hash sidecar for the product-subagent-permissions note's heading blocks.

Each product Provider owns a Profile-level permissionMode (Claude Code dontAsk/acceptEdits/auto/plan); the tool schema and SubagentStartRequest carry no permission field, so a model cannot raise its own authority.
Chinese twin; its 问题 separates a permission refusal from other product-run failures.
Hash sidecar for the subagent-model-routes note's heading blocks.

A Host subagent-model-selection section stores an enabled switch plus an exact {provider, model} allowlist, snapshotted into each top-level Session as subagent/model-selection-policy and enforced in the delegation executor.
Chinese twin; its 决策 explains why the allowlist is not rendered into the delegation description (it would enlarge every request and invalidate an early prompt prefix).
Hash sidecar for the generic-file-upload note's heading blocks.
Non-image files upload through a FIFO queue into content-addressed DSH_HOME/attachments/v1 and reach the model as a read-only path handle inside user/message - no provider ever receives file bytes.
Chinese twin; its 决策 rejects storing uploads in the project root and eager prompt injection.
Hash sidecar for the auto-review note's heading blocks.
Experimental Auto-review layer reviews every native call and PTC inner call before its body, classifying risk low/medium/high by the action's actual effects rather than its name or claimed intention.
Chinese twin; its 决策 gives the low/medium/high risk table (low allow, medium needs explicit human authorization, high deny).
Hash sidecar for the session-write-lease note's heading blocks.
Cross-process session write lease uses kernel arbitration: POSIX flock(2) on session.lock and a Windows named semaphore, with an inode re-verification because a POSIX lock names an inode, not a path.
Chinese twin; its 决策 records that the first TTL+rename design was replaced in review and why LockFileEx and CreateFileW share-mode denial were rejected.
Hash sidecar for the in-history-system-prompt note's heading blocks.
On a model route declaring systemPromptUpdate:'in-history', a changed prompt is APPENDED as a new system/message node instead of rewriting message 0, keeping the DeepSeek provider prefix cache warm.
Chinese twin; its 决策 tabulates the four route/prefix-state operations and the startsSeries rule.
Hash sidecar for the right-sidebar-docking note's heading blocks.
The right column becomes a per-session docking surface (split panes, tabs, floating panels, undoable operations) over ui-dockkit, replacing the single-purpose Detail panel that duplicated chat cards.
Chinese twin; its 问题 names the Detail panel's duplication and the plugin-hostile single slot.
Hash sidecar for the deepseek-messages-adapter note's heading blocks.

DeepSeek is served over the Anthropic Messages protocol with a versioned ReplayEnvelope storing only block kinds and signatures, so thinking survives across tool turns; effort uses output_config.effort.
Chinese twin; its 决策 notes that capability is declared per endpoint/model and never inferred from a protocol or model name.
Hash sidecar for the present-workspace-source-files note's heading blocks.

The present tool declares existing workspace source files by path with no content copy; an authenticated POST selects a declaration by session/event/index and the Host opens it in the default application.
Chinese twin; its 问题 states that preserving an independent delivered version adds storage, copy verification and a second editing destination.
Hash sidecar for the web-sidebar-terminal note's heading blocks.

Web sidebar terminals (xterm.js over api-terminal-controller) are human-facing and independent of the Agent's persistent terminals; close cleanup is recorded in a terminal-specific localStorage key and retried at startup.
Chinese twin; its 决策 explains why the browser renderer must not be the Agent's readiness oracle.
Hash sidecar for the explicit-worktree-creation note's heading blocks.

An experimental worktree runtime creates a named branch and checkout from a pinned local commit under .agents/worktrees and enters it via the shared working-directory service, without widening the Session sandbox policy.
Chinese twin; its 问题 explains that changing a shell cwd does not update the Session's later tools or recorded context.
Hash sidecar for the desktop-primary-runtime note's heading blocks.
Desktop ships a release-bound Python/Node/pnpm/Office payload installed from application resources, identified by a runtime.json digest over locked inputs rather than by directory name.
Chinese twin; its 决策 describes the macOS JIT entitlements and the Windows signed-packaging stages.
Hash sidecar for the terminal-reclamation note's heading blocks.
An unattended browser terminal is reclaimed only after no window holds it AND the Host continuously confirms idle for two hours; running work and unknown activity cancel the deadline.
Chinese twin; its 决策 tabulates retain/reclaim behaviour per window-holding and work state.
Hash sidecar for the browser-excel-preview note's heading blocks.

Browser Excel preview (FortuneSheet plus ExcelJS/SheetJS/PapaParse adapters) is read-only, keeps saved formula results, and strips DrawingML parts inside a temp ZIP so an undisplayable chart cannot hide readable worksheets.
Chinese twin; its 决策 names the ordered limits - source-byte limit before parsing, area limit before matrix allocation, timeout for stalled parsing.
Hash sidecar for the sidebar-browser note's heading blocks.

Sandboxed browser right-sidebar tab type; default Web policy is sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms allow-same-origin allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox" and the address parser rejects file:, credentials and the app's own origin.
Chinese twin; its 决策 distinguishes the Web page's live browsing context from Document Preview's byte renderer.
Hash sidecar for the sidebar-auto-refresh note's heading blocks.

On-demand OS watching plus automatic refresh for Sidebar previews and file trees; Resource holds metadata only and renderers read content, so metadata updates and content reloads stay separate responsibilities.
Chinese twin; its 问题 table separates the File Resource, Document Preview, workspace file events and Files panel and names each gap.
Hash sidecar for the mandatory-integrity note's heading blocks.

Every Windows ACL grant now applies three edits in one SetNamedSecurityInfoW: the capability allow ACE, a world-SID DENY on FILE_DELETE_CHILD (container-inherit only), and a Low mandatory label; the token is lowered to match.
Chinese twin; its 问题 names issue #4581 (cmd /c del and [System.IO.File]::Delete deleting outside the workspace).
Hash sidecar for the config-schema-dump note's heading blocks.
--dump-config-schema exits 1 on any partial/unsupported/error entry, discovers disabled rows too, and WIDENS native mutation cases instead of emulating Schemastery's write-back.
Chinese twin; its 决策 fixes the meaning of x-cordis.complete and the exit code for a partially approximate schema.
Hash sidecar for the desktop-browser-webview note's heading blocks.
Desktop uses a retained <webview> guest whose lifetime is independent of tab visibility, with Workspace-keyed storage partitions so related pages do not share site login state.
Chinese twin; its 问题 states that an iframe cannot expose cross-origin navigation or render sites that refuse embedding.
Hash sidecar for the spawn-agent-preset-selection note's heading blocks.

An explicit spawn preset id resolves the currently registered definition; omission joins the parent's exact live revision; independent selection is identified by the agent-preset/selected event preceding the child's first subagent/descriptor.
Chinese twin; its 决策 explains why an ordering marker beats adding a new descriptor field or event type.
Hash sidecar for the archive-stops-running-work note's heading blocks.

Archiving refuses by default when workspace/session-activity reports running work; stopActivity:true writes the archive first then stops it, and an agent/pre-step gate blocks any model step for an archived Session.
Chinese twin; its 决策 names the four activity families (turn/job/subagent/schedule) and each provider's own vocabulary.
Hash sidecar for the archive-admission-stored-tasks note's heading blocks.
The Schedule provider answers archive admission from the stored Host task rows (not a live-Session fold), so a cold Session with armed reminders still refuses the archive and names them.
Chinese twin; its 决策 explains that deleting rows through the public management path would deadlock the serialized queue.
Hash sidecar for the auto-review-fallback note's heading blocks.

A reviewer denial falls back to the tools pipeline's ask decision so a human can allow-once it; a reviewer FAILURE denies with a distinct message carrying the finish kind, failure code and provider message.
Chinese twin; its 决策 distinguishes a policy denial from a technical failure and rejects asking the user after a failure.
Hash sidecar for the session-inspector note's heading blocks.

Experimental Session Inspector sidebar page shows raw log, Chat structure and rendered conversation side by side, navigating by WeakMap identity rather than JSON, with a click-catching mask to pick the underlying record.
Chinese twin; its 决策 explains that runtime objects share Node/Turn/Step identities and contain cycles, so JSON cannot support reference navigation.
Hash sidecar for the plugin-market-discover note's heading blocks.

Experimental plugin-market bundle adds a Host pluginMarket service with volatile indexes config; search/entry accept only configured URLs, the Host filters and pages server-side (max 100 entries), and MiniSearch indexes CJK text as overlapping character pairs.
Chinese twin; its 决策 explains that index sources are user data and the Host never fetches a client-supplied address.
Hash sidecar for the plugin-market-index-format note's heading blocks.

One JSON index format (reusing npm names/versions/person fields) so a market can publish localized title/description, icon, versions and compatibility in one document a list page can render without per-row fetches.
Chinese twin; its 问题 explains why a bare npm-name list is too slow to render and fails partially.
Hash sidecar for the built-in-plugin-feature-previews note's heading blocks.
Plugin Manager maps built-in bundle names to {en, zh} preview images in one file; the tsdown client preset embeds them as data URLs. Explicitly not a plugin-author interface.
Chinese twin; its 决策 rejects a preview manifest field as a premature public contract for every plugin author.
Hash sidecar for the host-release-refresh-prompt note's heading blocks.
A release is the Host's version identity (version plus optional source commit); a page that reconnects to a different release is told to reload instead of hot-replacing plugins across releases.
Chinese twin; its 问题 lists the four technical causes, ending with Desktop being unaffected.
Hash sidecar for the deepseek-search-fetch-api note's heading blocks.

Direct DeepSeek Search/Fetch APIs register as deepseek-search-api/deepseek-fetch-api behind the existing web_search/web_fetch tools, selected by one switch writing web.searchProvider and web.fetchProvider together.
Chinese twin; its 决策 states the two protocols keep independent API bases and are never inferred from the hostname.
Hash sidecar for the node-engine-floor note's heading blocks.
Root engines.node set to ^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0; the floor is set by node:sqlite (22.13/23.4) and native TS type-stripping (22.18/23.6).
Chinese twin; its 决策 names the two Node features that gate the source runtime.
Hash sidecar for the serial-cross-platform-CI note's heading blocks.

A serial cross-platform CI reference re-proves the complete unsharded aggregate per hosted OS, kept out of branch protection, because a defect in the required gate inventory would otherwise go unnoticed.
Chinese twin; its 问题 explains why encoding performance targets as job timeouts is a separate failure mode.
Hash sidecar for the CI-failover-runbook note's heading blocks.
Two independent writer-manageable switches, DSH_CI_FAILOVER_LINUX and DSH_CI_FAILOVER_WINDOWS, recover hosted-pool outages without a merge, so the required checks cannot deadlock the fix.
Chinese twin; its 问题 states the outage deadlock - merging a fix waits on the required checks that cannot run.
Hash sidecar for the dependencies-over-hand-rolling note's heading blocks.

A stated dependency policy: replacing a hand-rolled surface with a maintained package is preferred when it nets real deletion, health and no new capability surface; vendored Cordis and twin adapters stay deliberate exceptions.
Chinese twin; its 问题 names the unstated "avoid new dependencies" reflex agents inferred from the repo pattern.
Hash sidecar for the frozen-agent-note-archive note's heading blocks.

Low-future-value implemented notes are DELETED as complete triplets, and only high-value historical ones are archived to .agents/notes/archived/{kind}/ with an Archived: line; .rgignore keeps the archive out of active discovery.
Chinese twin; its 决策 names the permitted archival edits (relocation, metadata line, sidecar re-record, link repair) and nothing else.
Hash sidecar for the worktree-local-lefthook note's heading blocks.

Git hook installation becomes worktree-scoped: extensions.worktreeConfig plus an absolute core.hooksPath at $GIT_DIR/dsh-hooks, guarded by a repository-scoped lock and format-0 migration safety checks.
Chinese twin; its 问题 explains that linked worktrees share the common repository's hooks directory.
Hash sidecar for the generated-third-party-notices note's heading blocks.
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md is generated from the workspace manifests and shared runtime lock, with freshness enforced inside the existing test lane rather than a new CI step or a Git hook.
Chinese twin; its 问题 says a hand-written inventory drifts silently the moment a package is added, removed or relicensed.
Hash sidecar for the native-github-stacks note's heading blocks.
Dependent PR chains of two or more use GitHub's native stack object (gh stack link / gh stack merge --yes --merge); cross-fork chains hard-stop and a partial landing requires an explicit boundary PR.
Chinese twin; its 问题 contrasts base-branch-only chains with GitHub's native stacked-PR object.
Hash sidecar for the native-windows-PR-CI note's heading blocks.
Every PR starts three native Windows jobs (build/coverage/native-tests) on a real Windows runner; Wine stays master-only because it cannot prove NTFS, DACL, ConPTY or crash durability.
Chinese twin; its 问题 states that the coverage audit found stale branch state had restored temporary LSP exclusions.
Hash sidecar for the github-label-taxonomy note's heading blocks.
Every open or merged PR carries exactly one kind/* label and at least one materially affected area/* label; closed-unmerged PRs keep migrated history but get no invented classification.
Chinese twin; its 问题 separates "what kind of change" from "which repository domains it affects".
Hash sidecar for the event-directed-PR-status note's heading blocks.

Review webhooks act as commands on the Issue Project: review_requested moves to In review; a submitted review with changes_requested moves to In progress, and only when the latest status was written by the lifecycle actor.
Chinese twin; its 问题 explains that aggregate PR review state cannot represent a handoff.
Hash sidecar for the npm-release-sequences note's heading blocks.
Three independent npm publication sequences (dsh / vendor / native); 933 hand-written peerDependencies "^0.0.1" had to go because that range excludes 0.0.2 and any prerelease.
Chinese twin; its 问题 records the private:true blocker and the ^0.0.1 peer-range blocker.
Hash sidecar for the ambiguous-origin-label note's heading blocks.
A case-insensitive ten-letter token is banned from all maintained tracked paths and text (code, filenames, generated catalogs); each use is replaced by the exact local concept.
Chinese twin; its 问题 lists the eight unrelated meanings the token had accumulated across the repository.
Hash sidecar for the published-dependency-faces note's heading blocks.
Published packages declare their browser/Host/typing relationships in different npm sections so npm's automatic peer installation does not traverse deep converging peer paths on every install.
Chinese twin; its 问题 names the peer-traversal cost that made the published CLI expensive to install.
Hash sidecar for the python-runtime-windows-hosted note's heading blocks.
The Windows x64 Python runtime CI target stays on hosted windows-2025; the self-hosted migration was reverted after three same-day silent-death failures on dsh-win-ci that passed on Linux and macOS.
Chinese twin; its 问题 gives the exact run IDs, times and the silent "dsh plugin add" child exit.
Hash sidecar for the blacksmith-failover-leg note's heading blocks.
DSH_CI_FAILOVER_LINUX/_WINDOWS additionally accept "blacksmith", retargeting jobs onto on-demand runners at their declared vCPU - but credential-holding, benchmark and spec-pinned jobs stay hosted.
Chinese twin; its 问题 rejects Blacksmith's wizard wholesale runs-on replacement as the default on three grounds.
Hash sidecar for the parallel-macos-notarization note's heading blocks.
One App is assembled and signed once, then copied with ditto so the ZIP lane (notarize+staple the App) and the DMG lane (package+sign+notarize the image) run in parallel over isolated copies.
Chinese twin; its 问题 explains that stapling modifies the App so the two lanes cannot share a writable directory.
Hash sidecar for the persistence-type-history note's heading blocks.
One normalized type model feeds the readable persistence catalog, the schema inventory and transitive per-root digests, with per-root acknowledgements and accepted checkpoint preservation.
Chinese twin; its 问题 states that a digest detects a difference but cannot explain it.
Hash sidecar for the default-product-experimental-isolation note's heading blocks.

verify-default-product-isolation follows runtime/optional/peer edges, resolves aliases and composes the default Web layers with the production patch parser so an experimental package cannot enter the default product by a transitive route.
Chinese twin; its 问题 explains why npm publication availability is not default-product membership.
Hash sidecar for the generated-cli-help-reference note's heading blocks.

The CLI reference is generated by capturing the dsh launcher, plugin forwarder and each shipped profile's help, then recursively discovering the Commands: subcommands; generation uses temp homes and needs no server or model.
Chinese twin; its 决策 notes the plugin forwarder shows its own help before pnpm arguments, so pnpm's flags are not DSH's.
Hash sidecar for the shipped-optional-bundles note's heading blocks.

OPTIONAL_BUNDLES names the experimental bundles the installation ships but does not enable; the isolation gate skips exactly the dependencies edge to a listed bundle and still rejects imports, presets or templates naming it.
Chinese twin; its 问题 notes that experimental packages were previously only findable on npm by name.
Hash sidecar for the persistence-schema-review note's heading blocks.

Persistence inventory format 2 records compatibility metadata per affected property with its binding, policy version, literal discriminator and unknown-kind preservation promise; policy-bearing graphs get a separate fingerprint domain.
Chinese twin; its 问题 explains that union-position-derived names change when unrelated siblings are added, hiding the fields a reviewer needs.
Hash sidecar for the windows-runtime-signature-cache note's heading blocks.

Signed runtime files are cached by original content + public certificate + SignTool bytes + script bytes + format, restored only after checking the input record, digest, Windows trust, timestamp and certificate.
Chinese twin; its 决策 requires a fixed local drive, current-account ownership and a private destination DACL for the cache.
Hash sidecar for the windows-signature-completion note's heading blocks.

Hardware signing and timestamping are split: sign once without a timestamp, release the hardware interlock only after Windows verifies the signature, then append a timestamp with at most three calls and 1-2 s delays.
Chinese twin; its 问题 explains that a combined SignTool command reports timestamp failure as signing failure.
Hash sidecar for the no-unknown-casts note's heading blocks.
New direct assertions to unknown are prohibited across first-party JS/TS (both as unknown and <unknown>), while an unknown declaration stays valid for external data.
Chinese twin; its 决策 explains that removing all existing assertions in one change would mix enforcement with unrelated fixture redesign.
Hash sidecar for the dual-release-install-layout-budget note's heading blocks.

The dual-release install-layout gate judges graph GROWTH by dshPackagesPerVersion * checkedDshEdges against MAX_RESOLUTION_WORK_UNITS = 875000, with the npm wall-clock limit derived as a hang guard only.
Chinese twin; its 问题 gives the measurement - 137-205 s on an idle host vs 288.59 s on CI, 4 percent under the 300 s deadline.
Hash sidecar for the pr-artifact-typechecks note's heading blocks.

Checked PR artifact builds compile every existing project reference with ONE serial tsc -b process, then run the ordinary Typert/bundling/Desktop/Web stages, omitting only the root test and script programs.
Chinese twin; its 问题 gives the baseline timings (304 s benchmark build prep, 84 s cold macOS arm64 Host profile).
Hash sidecar for the product-package-classification note's heading blocks.

Every nonexperimental package must have effective product use or an explicit entry in product-package-policy.ts; verify-product-use follows shipped profiles, preset children, runtime imports and dynamic mounts.
Chinese twin; its 问题 notes an SDK or deployment-configured provider can have a product role without appearing in the default GUI.
Hash sidecar for the session-reader-compatibility-review note's heading blocks.

Session versions follow READER compatibility, not schema difference: a same-version change is allowed when older readers resume correctly, ignore optional features safely, or refuse before execution/mutation/tail repair.
Chinese twin; its 问题 gives the optional environment header field as the worked example of a difference that does not force a bump.
Hash sidecar for the build-artifacts-check-split note's heading blocks.
pnpm run build splits into build:artifacts and build:check and runs both concurrently, so the two noEmit root programs (Host 68.5 s, Client 36.0 s) leave the serial critical path.
Chinese twin; its 问题 quantifies the three fixed costs on the serial path (249 s package-library build).
Hash sidecar for the lossless-build-speedups note's heading blocks.

Measured output-preserving build speed-ups: the @types/react symlink fan-out (65 locations, 5.6 M entry scans, 32.6 s), Typert inside the Host tsdown writeBundle (12.4 s block), and per-config globSync manifest lookups (3.95 s).
Chinese twin; its 问题 gives the fitted dose-response model Check = 26.9 + 0.494*N s.
Hash sidecar for the local-gate-speedups note's heading blocks.

Local hooks, pnpm run test, test:docs and doc-sync were profiled and de-bloated: 256 host CPUs vs a 64-CPU container quota started 255 Vitest forks (55.3 GiB RSS), 26000 Git prefix lookups cost 135.7 s, and Markdown was parsed repeatedly.
Chinese twin; its 问题 lists the six measured costs with their timings.
Hash sidecar for the experimental-dependency-policy note's heading blocks.

The dependency-declaration check now covers packages/*/*/package.json with no experimental exemption, and additionally scans each package's own worker/child-process entries read from its tsdown.config.ts under both build faces.
Chinese twin; its 问题 records 4 experimental client packages with peerDependencies and 82 unresolvable requests in one packed bundle.
Hash sidecar for the no-top-level-await note's heading blocks.

Package sources must not use top-level await: entry modules use an explicit async function main(), because top-level await makes module evaluation asynchronous and blocks the browser preview's CommonJS packer.
